sections.heading: Link to the announcement in the Royal Gazette
sections.html:
Following the Office of the Royal Society's announcement on the names of countries, territories, administrative areas and capitals, dated 29 June 2022, and its preparation of an announcement of the Office of the Prime Minister, General Prawit Wongsuwon, Deputy Prime Minister acting on behalf of the Prime Minister, signed the Announcement of the Office of the Prime Minister on the names of countries, territories, administrative areas and capitals, which was published in the Royal Gazette on 1 September 2022.
